description: Get the cards inside one slice of a portfolio breakdown (the drill-down for get_portfolio_breakdown). Premium-gated. Requires IWMM_API_KEY.

by.description: Dimension the slice belongs to. Must match the get_portfolio_breakdown call.

colors.description: Only for by=color: the same superset filter (W,U,B,R,G,C) passed to get_portfolio_breakdown, so the drill-down matches the aggregate row. Ignored for other dimensions.

key.description: Slice key from the breakdown: a set code, rarity, type, cost-basis bucket, or color code.

name: get_portfolio_breakdown_cards
